blocks.value: This certificate is proudly presented to

in recognition of successful demonstration of competency in workplace cultural awareness, 
diversity inclusion practices, and intercultural communication excellence.

The recipient has completed comprehensive training encompassing cultural humility, unconscious 
bias mitigation, cross-cultural communication strategies, religious and cultural accommodation 
practices, and development of inclusive organizational environments.
Program Title: Advanced Cultural Competency for Healthcare Professionals
This credential demonstrates ongoing commitment to culturally responsive practice and does not expire.

Assessment Components:
Theoretical Knowledge Assessment: Achieved
Practical Case Study Analysis: Competent
Workplace Application Project: Exemplary
Reflective Practice Portfolio: Submitted

Training Duration:40 Contact Hours
CPD Credits:40 Hours
